artifacts.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: one transparent strategy-game icon.
The reference supplies ONLY material finish, colour palette and contents. DO NOT copy its camera, diamond-shaped outline, perspective, silhouette, or visible facades. Create a newly reconstructed STRICT VERTICAL NADIR VIEW of its Stone Age settlement.

ABSOLUTE VIEW GEOMETRY: This is a roof plan, seen from a satellite directly above. Ground plane parallel to the image plane. Camera exactly 90 degrees downward, orthographic projection, no perspective. Every circular horizontal shape MUST be a perfect circle. All buildings rise toward the viewer, never lean toward the top of the image. Zero visible wall elevations anywhere. Roofs completely hide every hut wall and door. All fence posts are seen from the very top, showing small round tops only; no vertical shafts. No exterior side wall at the bottom of the icon. Front and back edges have IDENTICAL width. The whole icon must read as a circular map tile rather than an upright 3D miniature. Perfect circular palisade plan; NOT elongated, NOT diamond, NOT oval.

Settlement design: circular dirt enclosure, a narrow ring of closely packed small wood post TOPS around its edge. Bottom entry gap with a short rectangular wooden bridge in plan view. Four perfectly circular radial straw roofs placed inside the enclosure around an open centre; four small square hide tent rooftops with symmetric four-way folds interspersed among them. Central round stone campfire ring seen vertically down. Dirt paths winding between these footprints. Sparse green foliage patches, stones, firewood and small racks seen only from the top. Maintain the recognizable Stone Age city contents of the reference but draw all of them from exactly overhead. No people.
Style: finely textured hand-painted game art, rich straw texture, weathered brown wood, pale tan leather, warm ochre dirt, grey stones, small vivid green shrubs. Detailed surfaces with restrained shading and tiny contact shadows. Keep material realism. No architectural blueprint strokes, no abstract symbols.
Layout: square canvas, settlement occupies 80 percent of width, equal generous margins, all contents and bridge contained. True alpha-transparent background outside the circular ground patch. No black background, no checkerboard, no text, no labels, no multi-panel sheet.

KEY ACCEPTANCE CHECK before finishing: see only roof surfaces, ground surfaces, tops of rocks, and tiny tops of posts. A single hut front door or an exterior ring of tall visible fence shafts means the camera is WRONG. Straight overhead is mandatory.

artifacts.prompt:
Create ONE richly textured TOP-DOWN MEDIEVAL CITY MAP ICON on a true transparent background. This is an OVERHEAD ROOF PLAN illustration in the visual language of high-quality hand-painted tabletop battlemap art. Draw horizontal roof textures on flat plan footprints. Projection is exactly straight down with zero camera tilt. Absolutely every structure is seen from its top.

Circular fortified town footprint, cobblestone ground, narrow ring of light limestone wall TOP surfaces, ten round tower TOPS around its circumference. Each roofed tower is simply a perfect circular radial dark slate roof disc with apex at the disc centre. Each uncovered tower is a perfect circular crenellated ring around its flat round floor. Towers must have NO cylindrical side below their roof circles, not even a narrow strip. Walls appear only as narrow top surfaces between tower circles, never a visible outward-facing wall. Bottom-centre entrance gap and small rectangular stone entry path drawn in plan view.

Within the wall: a prominent elongated CROSS-SHAPED cathedral roof plan in the centre, roof ridge north-south, equally wide left and right roof planes, perpendicular transept, dark grey slate tiles, small buttress tops. Its southern end is simply the end of its roof plan, with NO front elevation, NO arch doorway or facade rose window. A separate small slate civic roof immediately north. Twenty-six small closely clustered house roof footprints on either side of the cathedral and around the boundary: vivid warm terracotta gable roofs and cool dark slate hipped roofs, clear evenly wide roof slopes, little chimney TOPS, intricate tile textures. Facades invisible beneath their roofs. Thin winding cobblestone lanes between these roof footprints. South of the cathedral a circular market plaza with fountain TOP in the centre and six small striped cream/red/gold rectangular market awning roofs around it. Small irregular tree-canopy clusters and shrub patches. No people.

Materials/style: polished fine hand-painted fantasy strategy-game art. Photographic richness of stone, slate, warm clay tiles, tiny foliage, weathered cobbles. Crisp roof ridges, fine surface detail, understated top-left lighting, soft tiny contact shadows entirely on ground. Dimensional feel comes solely from roof shading; do not expose vertical walls to show volume. Clearly a beautifully illustrated overhead city map instead of a tilted miniature.

Composition: one complete circular town isolated centrally on a square canvas, equal transparent margins, footprint fills 82 percent of canvas width, entry path fully inside image. No text, letters, border, UI or labels. Transparent alpha outside town, no black or white backdrop, no checkerboard.

Critical geometric rule: looking at any round roof you see a perfect circle; looking at a house you see only a rectangular or L-shaped roof footprint; looking at a tower you see a disc and NO wall cylinder. Ground has no foreshortening. The near and far sides are equally viewed from overhead.

artifacts.prompt:
Create one richly textured TOP-DOWN MODERN MILITARY BARRACKS MAP ICON on a genuine transparent background. This is a roof-plan illustration in the visual language of high-quality hand-painted tactical battlemap art. Treat the artwork as top-facing textures on flat plan footprints, with detailed roof materials and ground paint, rather than an upright model. Projection is exactly straight down with zero tilt.

Layout: square light-grey concrete military compound, perimeter aligned with image horizontal and vertical axes. Thin metal fence plan lines at all four edges, tiny evenly spaced square post tops. Four small square concrete guard-tower roof TOPS at four corners, no visible tower wall faces. Wide entry gap at south/bottom centre, yellow caution paint and red-white striped barrier drawn across it from above. Main headquarters footprint at centre of north/top edge, a large perfectly rectangular flat grey roof with three small rooftop HVAC squares and one antenna represented by its top point. Two long grey rectangular gabled barracks roofs run vertically on the left and right sides of the yard; each has a precisely centred ridge and equal-width roof slopes. Small rectangular utility roof at bottom right, small olive tent roof at bottom left. Silver horizontal cylinder fuel tank at top left is seen as a simple long rounded rectangular upper surface, with neither circular end face visible. Top-right concrete helipad with perfect yellow circle and white H, a dark olive helicopter seen purely from directly overhead with long tail and cross rotor. Middle open concrete yard, eight olive green truck and jeep roof silhouettes arranged in two orderly parking columns, horizontal parking spaces marked white. Vehicles show ONLY horizontal top surfaces, bonnet and roof: no visible wheel sidewalls, no side panels, no front faces. Few square olive crate TOPS around buildings.

Material style: finely textured realistic strategy-game illustration, weathered concrete ground, galvanized metal rooftops, dark olive painted equipment, white and yellow markings. Fine shingle and seam detail. Flat-roof HVAC modules show square top faces ONLY. Dimensional feel from slight roof-slope shading and tiny contact shadows directed down-right, not from vertical walls. Polished realistic roof textures without schematic blueprint linework.
Geometry is paramount: every building is ONLY a rectangular roof footprint. Roofs fully occlude ALL walls, facades, doors, vertical signs and front steps. Never show a band of vertical wall below a roof. Never show side walls of guard towers. All four perimeter edges have equal visual width. The helipad is a true circle and the compound a true square. View should resemble a detailed satellite roof map or a tabletop battlemap, absolutely not an isometric miniature.

Composition: one complete compound centred on square image canvas, footprint occupies 82 percent of image width and height, equal generous transparent margins all sides. Clean alpha edges with no stray pixels. No surrounding scenery, no people, no multi-panel layout, no watermark, no captions, no decorative border, no words except the single helipad H. Real alpha transparency outside square compound, no coloured backdrop, no black fill, no fake checkerboard.
